symptom: `search '<text>'` finds nothing that lives only in a **nanoflow, rule, JSON structure or mapping**, even right after `refresh catalog source`; `CATALOG.SOURCE` holds only ENTITY / ENUMERATION / MICROFLOW / SNIPPET / PAGE
cause: Two lists maintained in different packages drifted. `buildSource` (catalog) already collected nanoflows, rules and workflows, but `captureDescribeParallel`'s dispatch (executor) had no `rule` case and routed `"nanoflow"` to `describeMicroflow`, which searches `ListMicroflows()` only and so returns NotFound for every nanoflow. The worker loop then discarded both errors — `if err == nil && text != "" { ... }` — so the types produced zero rows and reported nothing. Measured: 114 collected, 100 inserted, the 14 dropped being exactly the 13 nanoflows + 1 rule
insight: Keep the type names as constants in `catalog.SourceObjectTypes` and make the executor's dispatch a table asserted against that list, so a collector added without a dispatch case fails a test instead of silently indexing nothing. **Pin each mapping by function identity** (`runtime.FuncForPC`) — a presence-only check passes the nanoflow bug, because the wrong function is still a function. Return describe failures instead of dropping them and report them grouped by type: a whole type failing is a wiring bug, one document failing is a property of that document. Verify at the catalog layer, not via `mxcli check` — the defect needs a project, so a `.fail.mdl` cannot express it (see the Makefile's `check-mdl` note). Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/912-catalog-source-all-doctypes.mdl`. Issue #912
